archetypes.label: Everyday tops
archetypes.covers: Blouses, shirts, polos, sweaters, sweatshirts, hoodies, t-shirts, tank tops, tunics, cardigans, bodysuits, overshirts.

decision_vectors.label: Size & fit
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Tops are the single most-returned apparel type on true-to-size mismatches; brand sizing is not standardized.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Compare the retailer's size chart (chest/length) against the user's known measurements or past purchases.
decision_vectors.data_source: listing size chart, user profile, past order history

decision_vectors.label: Fit style (slim / relaxed / oversized)
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Same nominal size drapes very differently by cut, independent of body measurements.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Read the listing's fit description and photos; weight toward the user's stated style preference.

decision_vectors.label: Fabric & care
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Determines comfort, breathability, wrinkle behavior, and whether it survives frequent washing.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Extract fiber content and care label from the listing.

decision_vectors.label: Occasion
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: A work-appropriate blouse and a lounge tee solve different problems even in the same subcategory.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match listing tags/description to the scenario's setting and stated purpose.

decision_vectors.label: Season & weight
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Fabric weight determines whether the top is wearable for the season the scenario is set in.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Cross-check garment weight/material against the scenario's timing.

decision_vectors.label: Price tier
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Everyday basics have enormous price spread for near-identical function.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Filter/sort candidates to the user's budget_tier band.

archetypes.best_way_to_buy: Favor retailers with free returns given how fit-dependent this category is.

archetypes.label: Footwear
archetypes.covers: All Shoes leaves — athletic shoes, boots, flats, heels, sandals, slippers, sneakers — and Baby & Children's Shoes.

decision_vectors.label: Size & width fit
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: The single dominant satisfaction/return driver in footwear; sizing varies significantly by brand and last shape.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Compare brand-specific size chart and width options to the user's known size/width.

decision_vectors.label: Activity use case
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Running, dress, casual, and hiking shoes have essentially disjoint construction and performance needs.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match to the stated activity in the use case.

decision_vectors.label: Material & weather suitability
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Breathability vs. waterproofing is a real tradeoff that needs to match climate/season.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check upper material against scenario setting/season.

decision_vectors.label: Arch support & comfort
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Matters disproportionately for all-day wear or buyers with known foot conditions.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Surface insole/support claims, especially for daily-wear use cases.

decision_vectors.label: Durability & sole quality
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Sole material and construction quality drive both comfort and how long the shoe lasts under its intended use.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check sole material and reviews for wear complaints.

decision_vectors.label: Growth room (children's sizing)
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: For kids' shoes specifically, a small growth allowance extends usable life without harming fit.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Bias size selection slightly larger for a growing child.

decision_vectors.label: Price tier
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Wide range from basic to technical/performance footwear.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Filter to budget_tier.

archetypes.best_way_to_buy: Confirm brand-specific size/width before anything else — this is the highest-return apparel category overall.

archetypes.label: Fine & fashion jewelry
archetypes.covers: Rings, necklaces, earrings, bracelets, charms & pendants, body jewelry, jewelry sets, anklets, brooches & lapel pins.

decision_vectors.label: Metal type & hypoallergenic properties
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Skin sensitivity/allergy is a common, decisive constraint (e.g. nickel-free requirement), not just a style choice.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check metal composition against any known sensitivity.

decision_vectors.label: Size fit (ring size / chain length)
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: The single largest return driver in this category, especially for rings.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match listing's size options to the user's known ring size / preferred chain length.

decision_vectors.label: Gemstone / material authenticity
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: For higher-value pieces, authenticity certification materially affects both value and trust.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Surface certification/authenticity documentation when present, especially above a price threshold.

decision_vectors.label: Occasion & symbolism
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Gift, engagement, and everyday-wear jewelry carry very different weight and expectations.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match to the use case's stated occasion.

decision_vectors.label: Care & maintenance
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Plating wears off, stones need re-tightening — matters for total cost of ownership.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Surface plating type and recommended care.

decision_vectors.label: Price tier / resale value
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Extremely wide range from costume jewelry to fine jewelry with real resale value.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Filter to budget_tier; flag resale-relevant certification at higher tiers.

archetypes.best_way_to_buy: For rings/chains, confirm exact size before anything else — it's the dominant return reason.

archetypes.label: Dresses, one-pieces & outfit sets
archetypes.covers: Dresses, one-pieces, and outfit sets (excluding bridal, maternity, kids and swim dresses, which have their own archetypes).

decision_vectors.label: Occasion & formality
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: A cocktail dress, a sundress, and a wrap dress for the office solve unrelated problems.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match listing occasion tags to the use case's event type.

decision_vectors.label: Size & body fit
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Dresses combine bust/waist/hip fit simultaneously, so mismatch risk compounds across three measurements.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Compare the listing's full size chart against the user's measurements.

decision_vectors.label: Fabric & drape
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Drape determines how the silhouette actually looks on the body, which a flat product photo often misrepresents.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Read fabric composition and check for reviewer photos where available.

decision_vectors.label: Length & silhouette
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Mini/midi/maxi and A-line/bodycon/wrap are the main axes of personal style preference in this category.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Weight candidates by brand_prefs and past purchase pattern.

decision_vectors.label: Season
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Fabric weight and sleeve length need to match the scenario's timing.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Cross-check against scenario timing/setting.

decision_vectors.label: Return policy
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Highest-return apparel category; a generous return window materially de-risks the purchase.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Surface the retailer's return window alongside the product.

archetypes.best_way_to_buy: Surface return window prominently; this is the highest fit-risk apparel category.

archetypes.label: Pants, shorts & skirts
archetypes.covers: Cargo pants, chinos, jeans, jeggings, joggers, leggings, trousers, and all adult shorts/skirts/skorts (excluding activewear, sleepwear, maternity and kids variants, which have their own archetypes).

decision_vectors.label: Waist & inseam fit
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: The two measurements that actually determine wearability, more reliable than a size label alone.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match listed waist/inseam range to the user's known measurements or prior purchases.

decision_vectors.label: Rise & silhouette
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: High/mid/low rise and slim/straight/wide leg change comfort and styling independent of size.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Read listing silhouette tags; weight by brand_prefs / past choices.

decision_vectors.label: Fabric & stretch
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Stretch percentage drives all-day comfort, especially for jeans and trousers.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Extract fiber content / elastane % from the listing.

decision_vectors.label: Occasion
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Work trousers, weekend chinos, and going-out skirts aren't interchangeable.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match to the scenario's setting/purpose.

decision_vectors.label: Durability & wash care
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Bottoms see more wear-and-wash cycles than most apparel; matters more for daily-driver pieces.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check fabric weight/denier and care instructions.

decision_vectors.label: Price tier
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Wide spread between fast-fashion and durable-denim price points for the same garment type.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Filter to budget_tier.

archetypes.best_way_to_buy: Favor retailers with a printed size chart and free returns — fit risk here is high.

archetypes.label: Activewear & performance wear
archetypes.covers: Activewear pants/tops/sweatshirts/vests & jackets, sports bras, leotards & unitards, boxing shorts, dance costumes.

decision_vectors.label: Sport-specific fit
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Compression, freedom-of-movement, and chafe-prevention needs differ sharply by activity (running vs. yoga vs. lifting).
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match listing's stated activity use-case to the scenario.

decision_vectors.label: Moisture-wicking fabric
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Core functional differentiator versus ordinary loungewear at a similar silhouette.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check fabric technology claims (e.g. polyester blends, brand-specific wicking tech).

decision_vectors.label: Support level
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Especially for sports bras — under/over-supporting for the activity is a common complaint driving returns.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match support rating (low/medium/high impact) to the stated activity.

decision_vectors.label: Breathability
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: High-exertion use cases need airflow that casualwear fabrics don't provide.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check for mesh panels / ventilation claims.

decision_vectors.label: Durability under frequent washing
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Activewear is washed far more often than average apparel, accelerating fabric breakdown.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check fabric quality tier and reviews for pilling/stretch-out complaints.

decision_vectors.label: Price tier
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Large premium for named performance-fabric technology over generic blends.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Filter to budget_tier.

archetypes.best_way_to_buy: Prioritize matching the activity claim over general brand popularity.

archetypes.label: Baby & children's clothing
archetypes.covers: All Baby & Children's Clothing leaves: tops, bottoms, dresses, one-pieces, outerwear, outfits, sleepwear, socks & tights, swimwear, underwear, diaper covers.

decision_vectors.label: Age/size & growth room
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Kids outgrow clothing in months; sizing by age band plus a growth allowance matters more than exact fit.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match listing's age/size chart to the child's age or last known size, and bias toward slightly larger.
decision_vectors.data_source: listing size chart, user profile (household context)

decision_vectors.label: Safety & materials
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Small parts, drawstrings, and harsh dyes are real safety/skin concerns unique to this archetype.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check for safety certifications and non-toxic dye claims, especially for infants.

decision_vectors.label: Durability under frequent washing
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Kids' clothing is washed and stressed (play, spills) far more than adult apparel of the same price.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check fabric quality and reinforced-seam claims.

decision_vectors.label: Comfort for sensitive skin
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Tagless labels, soft seams, and breathable fabric matter more for children, especially infants.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check listing callouts (tagless, organic cotton, etc.).

decision_vectors.label: Occasion
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Everyday play clothes and special-occasion outfits have very different durability-vs-style tradeoffs.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match to the use case's stated purpose.

decision_vectors.label: Price tier
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Fast outgrow rate makes many households deliberately budget-conscious here regardless of general budget_tier.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Default toward value pricing unless the use case signals otherwise (e.g. a special occasion).

archetypes.best_way_to_buy: Default to value price points given the short usable lifespan, unless the use case is occasion-specific.

archetypes.label: Outerwear, coats & jackets
archetypes.covers: Coats & jackets (bomber, puffer, trench, parka, etc.), vests, motorcycle outerwear, rain suits/pants, snow pants & suits, chaps.

decision_vectors.label: Warmth / insulation rating
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: The primary functional spec — down fill weight or insulation type determines usable temperature range.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Extract fill power/insulation type from the listing and match to the scenario's climate.

decision_vectors.label: Weather protection
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Waterproof/windproof rating matters far more here than in any other apparel archetype.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check listed waterproof rating (e.g. mm hydrostatic head) if present.

decision_vectors.label: Layering fit
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Outerwear needs to fit over whatever's worn underneath — sizing runs differently from a standalone top.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Recommend sizing up when the use case implies heavy layering (e.g. winter hiking).

decision_vectors.label: Material & durability
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Outerwear is typically a multi-year purchase, so build quality matters more than in fast-turnover categories.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check shell material and stitching/seam-sealing claims.

decision_vectors.label: Weight & packability
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Relevant for travel or activity use cases where the jacket needs to pack down.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check packed weight/volume if the use case involves travel.

decision_vectors.label: Price tier
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Technical outerwear has a very wide price range tied directly to performance claims.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Filter to budget_tier.

archetypes.best_way_to_buy: Weight heavily toward weather/warmth specs matching the scenario's actual climate, not just style.

archetypes.label: Lingerie, intimates & shapewear
archetypes.covers: Bras, bodysuits, camisoles, hosiery, jock straps, petticoats, shapewear, women's underpants/undershirts/slips, bra & lingerie accessories.

decision_vectors.label: Sizing accuracy (band/cup or waist)
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Brand-to-brand sizing is notoriously inconsistent in this category, more than almost any other apparel type.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Cross-reference the retailer's specific size chart rather than assuming standard sizing.

decision_vectors.label: Support level
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Functional requirement (everyday support vs. shapewear compression vs. minimal coverage) drives satisfaction more than style.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match listing's support/compression rating to the stated need.

decision_vectors.label: Fabric comfort & breathability
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Worn against skin all day; irritation is the top complaint driver in reviews.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check fiber content and review sentiment on comfort.

decision_vectors.label: Coverage & style
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Highly personal preference axis independent of fit or function.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Weight by brand_prefs / past purchases.

decision_vectors.label: Return/exchange policy
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Many retailers mark intimates as final-sale, which is decision-relevant given the high size-mismatch rate.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Surface the retailer's final-sale/exchange policy explicitly.

decision_vectors.label: Price tier
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Wide spread between basics multi-packs and premium fitted pieces.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Filter to budget_tier.

archetypes.best_way_to_buy: Flag final-sale/no-return policies clearly before purchase given high size-mismatch risk.

archetypes.label: Swimwear
archetypes.covers: Adult swimwear: boardshorts, bikinis, one-piece swimsuits, cover-ups, rash guards, swim briefs/boxers, swimwear tops, surf tops.

decision_vectors.label: Size fit (bust/waist/hip)
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Combines multiple body measurements at once; one of the highest-anxiety apparel purchases.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match the listing's full size chart to the user's measurements.

decision_vectors.label: Coverage & style
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Highly personal comfort preference, independent of size or activity.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Weight by brand_prefs / past purchases.

decision_vectors.label: Support structure
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Underwire/padding/adjustable straps materially affect comfort and suitability for swimming vs. lounging.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match to the stated activity (active swim vs. beach lounging).

decision_vectors.label: Fabric chlorine/UV resistance
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Pool chlorine and sun exposure degrade cheap fabric quickly; matters more for frequent swimmers.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check fabric composition (chlorine-resistant blends) against frequency of use.

decision_vectors.label: Occasion (pool / beach / swim-sport)
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: A competitive swim suit and a beach vacation suit are different products entirely.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match to the use case's setting.

decision_vectors.label: Price tier
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Wide spread between fast-fashion and technical swimwear.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Filter to budget_tier.

archetypes.best_way_to_buy: Favor retailers with a detailed size chart and lenient returns given the fit-anxiety in this category.

archetypes.label: Sleepwear & loungewear
archetypes.covers: Pajamas, nightgowns, robes, onesies, long johns, loungewear tops/bottoms.

decision_vectors.label: Fabric comfort & breathability
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Worn for extended low-activity periods; softness and temperature regulation dominate satisfaction.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check fiber content (cotton/modal/flannel) against season.

decision_vectors.label: Size fit (relaxed vs. snug)
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Preference for loose vs. fitted sleepwear is strongly personal and fairly stable per user.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Weight by past purchase pattern.

decision_vectors.label: Season & weight
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Flannel vs. lightweight cotton needs to match climate/season.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Cross-check fabric weight against scenario timing.

decision_vectors.label: Care instructions
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Frequency of wash is high; easy-care fabric matters for everyday use.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check care label.

decision_vectors.label: Style & coverage
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Personal comfort/modesty preference independent of fit or fabric.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Weight by brand_prefs.

decision_vectors.label: Price tier
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Wide range between basic sets and premium sleepwear brands.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Filter to budget_tier.

archetypes.best_way_to_buy: Weight comfort/fabric specs over styling — this is a comfort-first category.

archetypes.label: Headwear & hats
archetypes.covers: All Hats leaves (baseball caps, beanies, fedoras, etc.), Headwear (fascinators, headdresses, turbans), Baby & Children's Hats.

decision_vectors.label: Head size & fit
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Ill-fitting hats are uncomfortable and visibly wrong in a way clothing size mismatches often aren't.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match listing's head-circumference sizing/adjustability to the user.

decision_vectors.label: Weather protection (sun/rain/cold)
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Functional purpose varies hugely across this archetype — a sun hat and a winter beanie solve opposite problems.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match to the scenario's setting/season.

decision_vectors.label: Style & occasion
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Ranges from purely functional to a strong personal-style statement (fascinators, fedoras).
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Weight by use-case occasion and brand_prefs.

decision_vectors.label: Adjustability
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Adjustable straps/bands reduce fit risk significantly versus a single fixed size.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Prefer adjustable options when the user's head size is unknown.

decision_vectors.label: Material & durability
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Straw, wool, and technical fabrics have very different lifespans and care needs.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check material against intended frequency of use.

decision_vectors.label: Price tier
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Range from inexpensive basics to designer/formal headwear.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Filter to budget_tier.

archetypes.best_way_to_buy: Prefer adjustable sizing to de-risk fit unless the user's exact size is already known.

archetypes.label: Suits
archetypes.covers: Pant suits, skirt suits, tuxedos.

decision_vectors.label: Size fit & tailoring needs
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Off-the-rack fit is rarely perfect; whether alterations are realistic changes which product actually works.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Flag likely alteration needs based on size-chart deviation from the user's measurements.

decision_vectors.label: Fabric quality
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Wool content and construction quality drive both appearance and how the piece holds up to repeat wear.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check fabric composition and construction claims (e.g. half- vs. full-canvas).

decision_vectors.label: Occasion & dress code
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Business, black-tie, and wedding-guest dress codes call for genuinely different garments.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match to the use case's stated dress code.

decision_vectors.label: Color & style
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Versatility (navy/charcoal) vs. statement pieces is a real tradeoff for a wardrobe-planning purchase.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Weight by stated occasion frequency (one-off vs. recurring need).

decision_vectors.label: Alteration availability
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Timeline-sensitive if there's an event date; not every retailer offers or partners for alterations.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Surface whether the retailer offers alteration services.

decision_vectors.label: Price tier
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Enormous price range from rental-grade to bespoke; budget_tier materially narrows the field.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Filter to budget_tier.

archetypes.best_way_to_buy: Surface alteration lead time against the event date when the scenario has one.

archetypes.label: Bridal & wedding-party dresses
archetypes.covers: Wedding dresses, bridal party dresses.

decision_vectors.label: Size fit & alteration lead time
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Near-universal need for alterations; lead time against the wedding date is often the binding constraint, more than price or style.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Compare estimated alteration turnaround to the time remaining before the event.

decision_vectors.label: Fabric & silhouette
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Season, venue formality, and body preference all drive this heavily-personal choice.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match to stated venue/season and past style signals.

decision_vectors.label: Preservation & care
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Unlike ordinary apparel, buyers often plan for long-term preservation, not routine wear.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Surface fabric care needs and preservation service availability.

decision_vectors.label: Timeline to event
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Drives urgency and whether custom/made-to-order options are even viable.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Compare production/shipping lead time to the event date.

decision_vectors.label: Budget for one-time use
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Spend-per-wear reasoning doesn't apply the way it does elsewhere in apparel; budget_tier needs to be read as a hard ceiling, not a preference.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Treat stated budget as a firm constraint rather than a soft signal.

decision_vectors.label: Return policy
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Many bridal purchases are final-sale or custom, materially raising the stakes of getting size/style right upfront.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Surface the policy explicitly before purchase.

archetypes.best_way_to_buy: Lead with alteration/lead-time feasibility against the event date before style or price.

archetypes.label: Bags, wallets & cases
archetypes.covers: Handbags (all styles), wallets & money clips, badge/business-card/checkbook holders, keychains, lanyards, wallet chains.

decision_vectors.label: Size & capacity
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Whether it actually fits what the user needs to carry (laptop, daily essentials, event-specific items) is the primary functional question.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match listing dimensions/capacity claims to the use case's carrying needs.

decision_vectors.label: Material & durability
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Leather vs. synthetic vs. canvas trades off cost, longevity, and maintenance very differently.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check material composition and construction claims.

decision_vectors.label: Organization & compartments
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Practical daily usability often matters more than style once size/material are settled.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check listed compartment/pocket layout against stated needs (cards, phone, keys, etc.).

decision_vectors.label: Occasion / use case
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Everyday, travel, and formal-event bags have essentially disjoint requirements.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match to the use case's setting/purpose.

decision_vectors.label: Style & color
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Strong personal-style axis, especially for handbags.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Weight by brand_prefs / past purchases.

decision_vectors.label: Price tier
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Enormous spread from basic to luxury/designer within the same functional category.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Filter to budget_tier.

archetypes.best_way_to_buy: Anchor first on capacity/use case fit, then filter style and price within that.

archetypes.label: Uniforms & workwear
archetypes.covers: Contractor pants & coveralls, flight suits, food service uniforms, military/school/security/sports uniforms, scrubs, white coats.

decision_vectors.label: Compliance with required spec
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Often dictated by an employer, school, or regulation, not personal taste — the wrong color/style is simply non-compliant.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match listing exactly against the stated required spec (color, insignia, style code) before any other vector.

decision_vectors.label: Durability under industrial wash/wear
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Worn daily and often industrially laundered; fabric breakdown is a real cost-of-ownership factor.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check fabric weight and industrial-wash-safe claims.

decision_vectors.label: Safety features
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Flame-resistance, hi-vis, or antimicrobial properties are non-negotiable in some roles.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check for relevant safety certifications tied to the occupation.

decision_vectors.label: Size fit
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Worn for full shifts; poor fit has real comfort and safety consequences (e.g. loose fabric near equipment).
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match size chart to user profile.

decision_vectors.label: All-day wear comfort
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Breathability and stretch matter more here than in occasional-wear apparel.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check fabric composition and reviews from same-occupation buyers where available.

decision_vectors.label: Price tier & bulk value
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Often bought in multiples; per-unit price at bulk quantities is the real comparison.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Compare per-unit price across pack sizes.

archetypes.best_way_to_buy: Treat required spec/compliance as a hard filter applied before any preference-based ranking.

archetypes.label: Traditional & ceremonial clothing
archetypes.covers: Kimonos, saris & lehengas.

decision_vectors.label: Regional sizing & drape
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Sizing conventions and draping style are region/culture-specific and don't map to Western size charts.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match against the garment's own regional sizing convention, not a generic chart.
decision_vectors.data_source: listing specs specific to the garment tradition

decision_vectors.label: Fabric authenticity & craftsmanship
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Buyers in this category often specifically value handwoven/traditional-technique fabric over mass production.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Surface fabric origin and craftsmanship claims explicitly.

decision_vectors.label: Occasion significance
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Frequently tied to a specific cultural or religious event where the wrong formality reads as a real mistake.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match to the stated occasion.

decision_vectors.label: Care instructions
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Often dry-clean-only or hand-wash-only, unlike most everyday apparel.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Surface care requirements prominently.

decision_vectors.label: Customization / tailoring availability
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Many pieces are made-to-measure or need draping assistance; lead time is a real constraint.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check whether the retailer offers customization and its lead time.

decision_vectors.label: Price tier
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Wide range from ready-to-wear to heavily embellished custom pieces.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Filter to budget_tier.

archetypes.best_way_to_buy: Confirm customization lead time against the event date before finalizing style.

archetypes.label: Socks & hosiery
archetypes.covers: All Clothing > Socks leaves, Lingerie > Hosiery, and Baby & Children's Socks & Tights.

decision_vectors.label: Size fit (shoe-size based)
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Sized off shoe size rather than body measurement, and often the wrong axis if bought carelessly.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match listing's shoe-size range to the user's known shoe size.

decision_vectors.label: Activity use (athletic / dress / thermal / everyday)
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Cushioning, height (ankle/crew/knee), and material all follow from intended use.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match to the use case's activity context.

decision_vectors.label: Fabric material
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Cotton, wool, and compression/nylon blends serve different comfort and durability needs.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check fiber content against the season/activity.

decision_vectors.label: Pack quantity & value
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Almost always bought in multi-packs; per-pair price is the meaningful comparison unit.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Normalize price per pair across pack sizes.

decision_vectors.label: Durability under wash
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Heel/toe wear-through is the dominant failure mode; matters for value comparison.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check reviews for durability complaints.

decision_vectors.label: Price tier
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Wide spread from basic multi-packs to technical/compression hosiery.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Filter to budget_tier.

archetypes.best_way_to_buy: Compare on price-per-pair across pack sizes, not sticker price.

archetypes.label: Belts & buckles
archetypes.covers: Belts, belt buckles, baby & children's belts.

decision_vectors.label: Waist size fit
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Straightforward but essential — the wrong length range makes the item unusable regardless of style.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match listing's length range to the user's waist size.

decision_vectors.label: Material quality (leather vs. synthetic)
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Drives both longevity and formality level.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check material composition.

decision_vectors.label: Buckle style
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Primary style-differentiation axis in this category.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Weight by brand_prefs.

decision_vectors.label: Occasion (casual / formal)
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Casual and formal belts are rarely interchangeable in styling.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match to use-case occasion.

decision_vectors.label: Reversibility
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Reversible belts offer two looks per purchase, a real value consideration.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Surface reversible options when budget-conscious.

decision_vectors.label: Price tier
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Wide range from basic to premium leather goods.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Filter to budget_tier.

archetypes.best_way_to_buy: Confirm exact waist-size range before style — this is the most common return reason.

archetypes.label: Watches & smartwatches
archetypes.covers: Watches, smart watches, watch accessories (bands, winders, stickers).

decision_vectors.label: Case size & wrist fit
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Case diameter and band length/adjustability determine whether it's comfortable and proportionate to the wearer.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match case size and band range to the user's known wrist size or past watches.

decision_vectors.label: Features (smart vs. analog)
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Fundamentally different purchase decisions — health tracking and notifications vs. pure timepiece/style.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match to the use case's stated need (fitness tracking vs. everyday style vs. gift).

decision_vectors.label: Battery life & water resistance
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: For smartwatches, battery life is a top satisfaction driver; water resistance matters for both types if used during activity.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check specs against the use case's activity context.

decision_vectors.label: Band material & compatibility
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Interchangeable-band ecosystems add long-term value; band material affects daily comfort.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check band material and standard/proprietary attachment.

decision_vectors.label: Style & occasion
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Ranges from purely functional fitness tool to a status/style accessory.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Weight by brand_prefs and use-case occasion.

decision_vectors.label: Price tier
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Enormous range from basic quartz to luxury/premium smartwatches.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Filter to budget_tier.

archetypes.best_way_to_buy: Clarify smart vs. analog intent first — it's a bigger fork than any style preference.

archetypes.label: Sunglasses
archetypes.covers: Sunglasses.

decision_vectors.label: UV protection / lens category
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: The core functional/safety spec — not all cheap sunglasses provide adequate UV protection despite looking similar.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Verify listed UV protection rating (e.g. UV400) explicitly.

decision_vectors.label: Face shape fit
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Frame shape flattering a given face shape is the dominant style-satisfaction driver.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match frame shape recommendations to the user's stated/known face shape if available.

decision_vectors.label: Lens type (polarized / photochromic / mirrored)
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Functional differentiator for driving, water sports, or general glare reduction.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match to the use case's activity context.

decision_vectors.label: Frame material & durability
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Acetate, metal, and TR-90 plastic trade off weight, flexibility, and price.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check frame material against intended use (e.g. sport vs. everyday).

decision_vectors.label: Prescription compatibility
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Relevant subset of buyers need prescription lens insert compatibility.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Surface prescription-ready options when relevant.

decision_vectors.label: Price tier
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Enormous range from basic to designer/luxury frames.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Filter to budget_tier.

archetypes.best_way_to_buy: Never compromise the UV-protection check regardless of style or price preference.

archetypes.label: Men's undergarments
archetypes.covers: Men's underwear (boxer briefs, boxers, briefs, trunks, jockstraps, etc.), undershirts, long johns.

decision_vectors.label: Size & waist fit
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Comfort-critical, all-day-worn category where fit is the dominant satisfaction driver.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match listing's waist-size chart to the user's known size.

decision_vectors.label: Support style (brief / boxer / trunk / jockstrap)
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Style preference here is strongly personal and usually consistent for a given user.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Weight heavily toward the user's past purchase pattern.

decision_vectors.label: Fabric breathability
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Cotton vs. moisture-wicking synthetic materially changes comfort and odor over a full day.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check fiber content.

decision_vectors.label: Pack quantity & value
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Commonly bought in multi-packs; per-unit price and pack size matter as much as the individual item.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Compare per-unit price across pack sizes.

decision_vectors.label: Durability under frequent washing
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Highest wash-frequency apparel category; elastic waistband breakdown is the main failure mode.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check reviews for waistband/elastic longevity complaints.

decision_vectors.label: Price tier
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Large spread between basic multi-packs and premium performance fabrics.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Filter to budget_tier.

archetypes.best_way_to_buy: Default to the user's established support-style preference; treat as a repeat/replenishment purchase.

archetypes.label: Neckwear & formalwear accessories
archetypes.covers: Neckties, cufflinks, tie clips, collar stays, button studs, suspenders.

decision_vectors.label: Occasion & dress code
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Business, black-tie, and wedding dress codes call for genuinely different formality levels of these accessories.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match to the stated dress code.

decision_vectors.label: Color & pattern coordination
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Almost always bought to coordinate with a specific existing outfit, not standalone.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match to any stated outfit/color context.

decision_vectors.label: Material / silk quality
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Drives both appearance (sheen, drape) and price tier for neckties specifically.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check fabric composition.

decision_vectors.label: Width & style trend
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Tie width and lapel-era styling go in and out of fashion; matters for a cohesive look.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Weight by brand_prefs and recent style signals.

decision_vectors.label: Care instructions
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Silk ties typically require dry cleaning, unlike most accessories.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Surface care requirements.

decision_vectors.label: Price tier
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Range from basic to designer silk pieces.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Filter to budget_tier.

archetypes.best_way_to_buy: Anchor to the dress code and any existing outfit color before browsing style.

archetypes.label: Hair accessories
archetypes.covers: Hair bands, combs, extensions, forks & sticks, nets, pins/claws/clips, wreaths, headbands, ponytail holders, tiaras, wigs & wig accessories.

decision_vectors.label: Hair type compatibility
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Grip/hold performance varies significantly by hair thickness and texture (fine, thick, curly).
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match product claims (e.g. 'for thick hair') to the user's stated or known hair type.

decision_vectors.label: Material & comfort (grip, no-slip)
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Comfort over hours of wear and reliable hold are the top satisfaction drivers.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check material and grip-technology claims.

decision_vectors.label: Occasion & style
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Ranges from purely functional (everyday hold) to decorative/formal (tiaras, wreaths).
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match to the use case's occasion.

decision_vectors.label: Durability
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Small accessories are prone to breaking; matters for value comparison, especially multi-packs.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check reviews for durability complaints.

decision_vectors.label: Color match
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: For wigs and extensions specifically, color match to natural hair is the dominant satisfaction driver.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match listing color code to the user's stated hair color.

decision_vectors.label: Price tier
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Wide range from basic multi-packs to premium wigs/extensions.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Filter to budget_tier.

archetypes.best_way_to_buy: For wigs/extensions, treat color match as a hard filter before any other vector.

archetypes.label: Costumes & costume accessories
archetypes.covers: Costume sets & dresses, costume shoes, costume accessories, masks.

decision_vectors.label: Size fit for one-time use
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Buyers typically accept looser sizing tolerance than for everyday apparel since wear is brief.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Use a wider acceptable size-match tolerance than other apparel archetypes.

decision_vectors.label: Occasion / theme accuracy
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: The entire point of the purchase is matching a specific character or theme correctly.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match listing description tightly against the stated theme/character.

decision_vectors.label: Comfort for the wear duration
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: A costume worn for a few hours has different comfort tolerance than one worn all evening (e.g. a party vs. a long parade).
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match to the scenario's duration.

decision_vectors.label: Material safety (esp. children's costumes)
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Flame-retardant treatment and non-toxic materials matter more for kids' costumes specifically.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check safety certifications when the use case involves a child.

decision_vectors.label: Accessory completeness
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Costumes often need matching accessories (mask, props) to read as complete.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Surface commonly-paired accessories from the same listing/brand.

decision_vectors.label: Price tier (one-time-use budget)
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Buyers are typically less willing to pay premium prices for single-use items.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Default toward value pricing unless the use case signals a recurring need (e.g. professional performer).

archetypes.best_way_to_buy: Default to value pricing; this is a single-use purchase for most buyers.

archetypes.label: Maternity clothing
archetypes.covers: All Maternity Clothing leaves: dresses, one-pieces, pants, skirts, sleepwear, swimwear, tops, nursing bras.

decision_vectors.label: Stage of pregnancy & growth room
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Fit needs change dramatically over ~9 months; the same size won't work through the whole pregnancy.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match listing's stated trimester range/stretch capacity to the current or expected stage.

decision_vectors.label: Belly support / panel type
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Full-panel, ruched, or under-belly styles serve different comfort needs and garment types.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match panel type to garment type and personal comfort preference.

decision_vectors.label: Nursing accessibility
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Relevant specifically for tops and nursing bras — clip-down or wrap access is a hard functional requirement, not a preference.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Filter to nursing-accessible designs when the item is a top or bra.

decision_vectors.label: Fabric comfort & stretch
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Skin sensitivity and comfort needs are often heightened during pregnancy.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check fiber content and stretch percentage.

decision_vectors.label: Versatility into postpartum
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Some buyers specifically value pieces that transition to postpartum/nursing use to reduce total spend.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Surface postpartum-wearability claims when present.

decision_vectors.label: Price tier
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: A temporary-use wardrobe; many buyers are deliberately budget-conscious here.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Filter to budget_tier, defaulting conservative.

archetypes.best_way_to_buy: Favor pieces with stated stretch/stage range and postpartum versatility to reduce total spend over the pregnancy.

archetypes.label: Scarves, wraps & head coverings
archetypes.covers: Scarves & shawls, bandanas & headties, sashes, handkerchiefs, leis.

decision_vectors.label: Fabric & season
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Wool vs. silk vs. cotton determines whether it's a warmth accessory or a pure style piece.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match fiber content to the scenario's season/setting.

decision_vectors.label: Size & dimensions
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Determines styling versatility (how it can be worn/tied) and whether it functions for its intended use (e.g. warmth vs. decoration).
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check listed dimensions against intended use.

decision_vectors.label: Styling versatility
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Many buyers value multi-way styling (neck, hair, bag) as a value driver.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Surface styling-versatility claims where present.

decision_vectors.label: Occasion
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Ranges from purely functional (cold-weather scarf) to occasion/cultural (leis, ceremonial sashes).
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match to the use case's stated purpose.

decision_vectors.label: Care instructions
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Silk and delicate fabrics often require special care unlike everyday accessories.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Surface care requirements.

decision_vectors.label: Price tier
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Wide range from basic to luxury (e.g. silk designer scarves).
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Filter to budget_tier.

archetypes.best_way_to_buy: Match fabric to season/purpose first; this category splits sharply between function and pure style.

archetypes.label: General small accessories
archetypes.covers: Catch-all for pinback buttons, decorative fans, wristbands, fashion face masks, traditional clothing accessories, maternity belts & support bands, bridal accessories, baby & children's protective wear.

decision_vectors.label: Use case / occasion
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: This bucket spans genuinely different purposes, so matching the stated occasion is the primary signal.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match listing description tightly to the use case.

decision_vectors.label: Material comfort & safety
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Several items in this bucket (support bands, protective wear) have real comfort or safety requirements, not just style.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check material and any relevant safety claims.

decision_vectors.label: Size fit / adjustability
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Where applicable (support bands, wristbands), fit affects whether the item functions at all.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Prefer adjustable options where sizing is uncertain.

decision_vectors.label: Style coordination
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Most items here are meant to complement an outfit or event, not stand alone.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match to any stated outfit/event context.

decision_vectors.label: Price tier
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Generally low-cost, occasional-purchase items.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Filter to budget_tier.

archetypes.best_way_to_buy: Treat this as a long-tail bucket — lean on the use-case description more than on general preference signals.

archetypes.label: Cold-weather & protective small accessories
archetypes.covers: Gloves & mittens, arm warmers & sleeves, leg warmers, earmuffs, hand muffs, balaclavas, neck gaiters, baby & children's gloves & mittens.

decision_vectors.label: Warmth / insulation
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Primary functional purpose; needs to match the scenario's actual temperature range.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match insulation claims to scenario climate.

decision_vectors.label: Size fit
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Poor fit defeats the functional purpose (cold gaps) more than it does for outer garments.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match sizing to user profile/age.

decision_vectors.label: Material & touchscreen compatibility
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: For gloves specifically, touchscreen compatibility is a common modern requirement.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check for touchscreen-compatible fingertip claims when relevant.

decision_vectors.label: Weather resistance
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Water-resistance matters for outdoor/snow use cases specifically.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match to scenario setting (outdoor/snow vs. indoor cold).

decision_vectors.label: Durability
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Small accessories are easily lost/worn out; buyers often value multi-packs or replaceable low-cost items.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Consider surfacing multi-pack options.

decision_vectors.label: Price tier
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Wide range from basic to technical cold-weather gear.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Filter to budget_tier.

archetypes.best_way_to_buy: Match insulation/weather-resistance to the scenario's actual conditions, not general style.

archetypes.label: Shoe accessories & care
archetypes.covers: Boot liners, gaiters, shoe covers, shoe grips, shoe inserts (arch supports, gel pads, heel cushions, anti-slip), shoelaces, spurs.

decision_vectors.label: Compatibility with the target shoe
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Inserts, laces, and liners need to fit a specific shoe type/size, not just the wearer.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match product sizing/compatibility to the shoe it's meant for.

decision_vectors.label: Material & function (cushioning vs. support vs. protection)
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Different problems (comfort, arch support, weatherproofing, traction) need genuinely different products.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match to the stated problem being solved.

decision_vectors.label: Size fit
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Wrong-sized inserts or covers are simply non-functional.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Match to shoe size.

decision_vectors.label: Durability
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Consumable-adjacent category (laces, inserts wear out); replacement frequency affects value.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Check reviews for longevity.

decision_vectors.label: Price tier
decision_vectors.why_it_matters: Generally low-cost category where value/multi-pack pricing matters more than brand.
decision_vectors.how_to_evaluate: Compare price across equivalent options.

archetypes.best_way_to_buy: Confirm compatibility with the specific target shoe before price or brand.
